# Command-line reference

<!-- Generated by scripts/docs/generate_reference.py. Do not edit. -->

The parser in `gcw.cli` owns this reference.

## `gcw convert`

```text
usage: gcw convert [-h] {hf} ...
```

## `gcw convert hf`

```text
usage: gcw convert hf [-h] --family {llama,qwen3,qwen3_5,qwen3_5_moe,gemma4}
                      --model MODEL [--variant {tf,bt,bgt,icarus,longshot}]
                      [--dtype {auto,bfloat16,float16,float32}] --out OUT
```

| Argument | Contract |
|---|---|
| `--family` | required; choices: `llama`, `qwen3`, `qwen3_5`, `qwen3_5_moe`, `gemma4` |
| `--model` | required |
| `--variant` | choices: `tf`, `bt`, `bgt`, `icarus`, `longshot`; default: `tf` |
| `--dtype` | choices: `auto`, `bfloat16`, `float16`, `float32`; default: `bfloat16` |
| `--out` | required |

## `gcw eval`

```text
usage: gcw eval [-h] {all,math,general,tasks,chat,fineweb} ...
```

## `gcw eval all`

```text
usage: gcw eval all [-h] (--checkpoint CHECKPOINT | --hf-model HF_MODEL)
                    [--processor {on,off}] [--limit LIMIT]
                    [--batch-size BATCH_SIZE]
                    [--prompt-mode {auto,plain,thinking_off,thinking_on}]
                    [--out OUT]
```

| Argument | Contract |
|---|---|
| `--checkpoint` | flag |
| `--hf-model` | flag |
| `--processor` | choices: `on`, `off`; default: `on` |
| `--limit` | type: `int` |
| `--batch-size` | default: `8`; type: `int` |
| `--prompt-mode` | choices: `auto`, `plain`, `thinking_off`, `thinking_on`; default: `auto` |
| `--out` | flag |

## `gcw eval chat`

```text
usage: gcw eval chat [-h] (--checkpoint CHECKPOINT | --hf-model HF_MODEL)
                     [--tokenizer-path TOKENIZER_PATH] [--processor {on,off}]
                     --tasks TASKS [TASKS ...] --mode
                     {thinking_off,thinking_on} [--batch-size BATCH_SIZE]
                     [--max-new-tokens MAX_NEW_TOKENS] [--out OUT]
```

| Argument | Contract |
|---|---|
| `--checkpoint` | flag |
| `--hf-model` | flag |
| `--tokenizer-path` | flag |
| `--processor` | choices: `on`, `off`; default: `on` |
| `--tasks` | required |
| `--mode` | required; choices: `thinking_off`, `thinking_on` |
| `--batch-size` | default: `8`; type: `int` |
| `--max-new-tokens` | default: `2048`; type: `int` |
| `--out` | flag |

## `gcw params`

```text
usage: gcw params [-h] {make} ...
```

## `gcw params make`

```text
usage: gcw params make [-h] [--family FAMILY]
                       [--processor-fraction PROCESSOR_FRACTION] [--out OUT]
                       [--target-non-embedding TARGET_NON_EMBEDDING]
                       [--regime {added_on_top,matched_total}]
```

| Argument | Contract |
|---|---|
| `--family` | default: `smollm360m` |
| `--processor-fraction` | default: `0.05`; type: `float` |
| `--out` | default: `configs/model/generated` |
| `--target-non-embedding` | type: `int` |
| `--regime` | choices: `added_on_top`, `matched_total`; default: `added_on_top` |
